chapter.verse: Tua ahih leh, Judah mite bang a hampha uh hiam? Vun ki-at hangin hamphatna a om hiam?
A pawlpawl phattuamna tampi a om hi. A lianbel phattuamna ahih leh, amaute kiangah Pasian’ thu a kipia zo hi.
Judah mi kimkhatte in upna nei lo ahih uh leh, a up lohna un Pasian’ dikna a siasak ding hiam?

Tua bang hi lo ding hi! “Na thupiakna in na thutan’na kilangsak hi, Thukhenna na thuak ciangin na gualzo ding hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin mi khempeuhte in thuciamna a pelh mi a kicih uh hangin, Pasian in thuman thutakpa hi ta hen.
Ahih hangin eite diklohna in Pasian’ dikna a kilatsak leh, bang thu gen ding a om hiam? Daan hong pia Pasian in ahi lopi-in bawl ahi hiam ci-in leitung ngeina bangin ka gen hi.
Tua bang hi zenzen lo ding hi. Tua bang ahih leh, Pasian in leitung mite bang ci thu a khen thei ding hiam?
Keima thuzuau hanga Pasian’ thuman in a vangliatna a khan’sak leh, bang hangin kei mawhna nei bang hong khen lai ding hiam?

Phatna a pian’ nadingin phat lohna gamta ni ci-in mi kimkhatte in hong kosia uh a, komau kam hong dawn’ kik uh mah bangin ka gen kik lai ding uh hiam? Tua bang a gente in thuman daan a thuak ding uh hi.

Tua ahih leh, bang kici ding hiam? Ei Judah mite in tua Gentailte sangin phazaw i hi hiam? Phazaw i hi zenzen kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Judah mi leh Grik mi khempeuhte in mawhna nei tuak uh hi cih thu a masa-in ka lak zo hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah: “Midik khat beek a om kei hi.
A thei khat beek a om kei hi. Pasian a zong mi khat beek a om kei hi.
Amau khempeuh in lam a pial zo uh hi, A vekpi-un a kiman’na om lo hi. A hoih a, gamta a om kei hi, Khat nangawn a om kei hi.
Amau gawlgui un a kihongsa hankhuk ahi uh hi. Amau leii uh tawh mi a kheem zo uh hi. Amau muk sung uh ah gul hangsante’ gu a om hi.
Amaute kam un hangsan’na leh kamkhauh tawh a dim hi.
Amau khe un mi sisan suah dingin a manlang hi.
Amau paina lampi-ah kisiatna leh gimna a dim hi.
Nopna lampi amau in a thei kei uh hi.
Pasian kihtakna thu Amau mittang mai uh ah a om kei hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Thukham in a gen thu khempeuh thukham nuai-ah a om mite kiangah a gen hi cih i thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin kam a vekpi kikham uh a, leitungmi khempeuhte in Pasian mai-ah mawhsakna a thuak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thukham tawh mawhna kilang ahih ciangin thukham a zuihna tawh, Pasian mai-ah kuamah in dikkisakna a ngah kei ding hi.
Tu-in Thukhamna leh kamsangte in teci a pan’ uh mah bangin, thukham loin Zeisu Khazih sungah thu-um mite khempeuh tungah upna hangin hong tung Pasian’ dikna kilang hi.
Kilamdan’na neukha beek a om kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khempeuh a mawh uh a, Pasian’ maipha a ngah nading uh kisia hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu Khazih in hong tan ahih maninah, a man pia loin Pasian’ hehpihna hangin dikkisakna i ngah hi.
Pasian in hong hehpihin a kihih khinsa mawhna a ngaihsut lohna in ama dikna thu kilat nangin ahi zongin,
tu laitak ama dikna hong kilangsak a, Zeisu a um mite diksa a, amahmah in dikna a bawl ding ahi zongin, Zeisu’ si thu-upna tawh mawh kimaisakna ding Zeisu a koih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kisaktheih nading koi-ah a om hiam na cih uh leh, a kipaaikhia zo hi. Bang thu tawh kipaai hiam? Gamtatna tawh kipaaikhia ahi hiam? Hi lo hi! Thu-upna tawh kipaaikhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khat in thukham bang gamta loin upna tawh dikkisakna a ngah hi ci-in i ciamteh hi.
Pasian in Judah mite’ Pasian bek ahi hiam? Gentailte’ Pasian zong hilo ahi hiam? Ahi mah hi. Pasian khat bek a om leh, Gentailte’ Pasian zong ahi hi.
Tua Pasian in upna bangin vun atte leh vun at lote a dik a sa ding hi.
Tua ahih leh, upna hangin eite in thukham paaikhia i hi hiam? Tua bang hi lo hi. Thukham i kip sak hi.
